raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":2908,"db":"POSTGRESQL","query":"SELECT nav_status, COUNT(DISTINCT mmsi) AS vessel_count FROM public.vessel_ais_data WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours' AND ST_Within(geom, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((119.45 35.30, 119.65 35.30, 119.65 35.45, 119.45 35.45, 119.45 35.30))', 4326)) GROUP BY nav_status"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"统计最近48小时内进入日照港石臼港区警戒区的船舶数量","tables":["POSTGRESQL:public.vessel_ais_data"],"columns":["mmsi","timestamp","geom"]},{"requirement":"按航行状态分组","tables":["POSTGRESQL:public.vessel_ais_data"],"columns":["nav_status"]}],"assumptions":["日照港石臼港区警戒区范围未在schema中定义，使用近似矩形POLYGON((119.45 35.30, 119.65 35.30, 119.65 35.45, 119.45 35.45, 119.45 35.30))表示"]}
